messages:
maria: Hey team — opened PR #3421 with the migration guide for the new batching config and updated SDK snippets. Docs preview is red: linkcheck + a couple Vale rules (passive-voice, cliche) are blocking the merge. Pls advise on reviewer timing, aiming to merge in tomorrow's docs window.

olivia: taking a look in ~30m. can you paste the linkcheck errors? :eyes:

maria: sure, paste from CI below:
```
Linkcheck: 2 broken links
 - /api/v1/old-batching -> 404
 - ../internal/kv-cache.md -> 404 (relative path issue)
Vale: 2 warnings -> treat-as-error (passive-voice, cliche)
```

jack: for the relative path, try updating to the absolute doc path `/docs/runtime/kv-cache.md`. relative links to parent folders broke after the refactor last week.

olivia: passive-voice warnings are on the short paragraph in the migration guide intro. quick fix is to change "is recommended" -> "we recommend" and tweak the sentence. i can push that small wording change myself if you want.

maria: that would be awesome, thanks. also there's one SDK snippet that uses `client.generate(..., max_tokens=1024)` which Vale flagged for a cliche phrase in the comment. i'll swap the comment to be more concrete.

docs-ci: docs-preview failed for PR #3421 — linkcheck error (2), vale error (2). Re-run with `/recheck` or push new commit.

maria: i'll make the two edits now and push a new commit. quick Q: does re-running the preview require any special perms?

docs-bot: /recheck executed by maria — queued. (Estimated time ~2m) :gear:

olivia: also tagging @jack as reviewer for the SDK snippet change — jack, can you verify the sample still works after the wording edits?

jack: yep i'll run the snippet locally once CI passes. if anything is off i'll push another tiny commit.

maria: pushed fix: swapped links to absolute paths and rewrote intro sentences. change set: 3 files. please re-run CI if you have perms or wait for docs-bot.

docs-ci: docs-preview started for PR #3421 (build 7821).

docs-ci: docs-preview succeeded for PR #3421 — all checks green.

olivia: great — i approved in the PR. :white_check_mark:

jack: LGTM from me after local run. small note: the code sample still uses `max_tokens=1024` which is fine but maybe add a comment about token budgeting for long prompts. not a blocker.

maria: good call — i'll add that follow-up as a separate PR to keep this one focused on the migration text. merging in today's docs window. thanks all! :rocket:

olivia: thanks maria. could you add a tiny changelog line in the docs index so release notes pick it up?

maria: added changelog line in the same branch, pushed. merging now.

docs-bot: PR #3421 merged by maria — docs published to staging.

jack: awesome, nice teamwork.

maria: thanks everyone :)
